# Fractional-order approach to covariance estimation for portfolio risk

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #3,703. ## Description

Proposed fractional-order approach to covariance estimation for portfolio risk: Estimate a more stable asset-return covariance matrix using regularization or geometric constraints, then use it for portfolio construction, risk budgeting, or hedging. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
